high_level_description: The image is a news headline from the website "Mint," which discusses economic data related to New Zealand. The background of the image features a world map with a focus on the continents of Africa, Europe, and parts of Asia. The map has a vintage or aged appearance, with a blue and yellow color scheme that gives it a somewhat nostalgic feel. In the foreground, there are three yellow blocks with black letters spelling out "GDP." These blocks are placed on top of the world map, suggesting a connection between global economics and the concept of Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
